method: built-in image_gen.imagegen, one sprite per call
fidelityLimit: Project reference identity; generated hidden geometry and panel details require review; requested camera degrees are intentions, not measurements.

views.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE individual transparent cinematic game sprite of the EXACT SAME Feral spacecraft shown by the two supplied project references. Image1 is its side/profile; image2 its dorsal/top view. These are references to the same rigid object, not suggestions for redesign. Keep broad chamfered wedge prow RIGHT, aft LEFT, upright, projected longitudinal axis horizontal. LOCK the flattened broad wedge shell, raised ribbed dorsal bridge, exact angular panel seams, small orange-red vent slits and underside hot grating, dark charcoal gunmetal worn surface, and EXACTLY TWO physical rear-side engine nacelles connected to the hull as shown in the top reference. Natural occlusion is allowed; never add a third engine or merge them. Preserve all existing shells and small emissive details. No Wolf flower prow, no round saucer dome, no cockpit glass, weapons, antennae, fins, new landing legs or new hatches. Use the same neutral soft upper-left lighting and restrained ember engine apertures; no new plume or large flare. Full ship centered on a1536x1024landscape canvas with at least6% clear alpha margin, all nacelles and prow tips intact. Genuine RGBA transparency outside physical silhouette, including openings. No scene, ground, shadow plane, background, haze, checkerboard, frame, text or watermark. Change only the three-dimensional camera angle below; never mirror or rotate a flat bitmap to fake the view.
CAMERA: a gentle12degree front three-quarter yaw from broadside toward the RIGHT prow, no pitch or roll. Reveal a little of the front/inner faces of the existing prow; rear nacelles recede. Keep every part rigid and in the same location on the hull.
